carrier.layout: 236 = [has prior, elapsed] + 18 slots x 13 (presence, 1, kind index/(K-1), kind confidence, 1, center x, center y, center available, motion x, motion y, motion available, 1, 1); presence threshold 0.5; motion = center difference / elapsed

physion.absorption: frames past a trial's end repeat its last frame

clevrer.all-at-rest: D = max(1, Delta): every frame of (f - D, f] has >= 1 object in view and every in-view object at planar speed <= 0.05; available iff f >= D
clevrer.enter-exit: debounced in-view set (>= 2 of the last 3 frames) differs between f - Delta and f; available iff f - Delta >= 2

macro.head: predicate_feedback.DeltaMacroPredictor (4 outputs per Delta)

physion.ocp-contact: C(g) = target touched zone on a native frame <= 3g; label C(f) != C(f - Delta); available iff f >= Delta; readout label = C(end)
physion.settled: D = max(1, Delta): push at or before native 3(f - D) and every object |v| <= 0.02, |omega| <= 0.1 on every native frame of (3(f - D), 3f]; available iff f >= D

macro.template: #113 observable predicates indexed by the landing frame; settle with debounce D = max(1, Delta); structure change by endpoint comparison per Delta

channel_0.clevrer: annotated collision of the pair at frame f (#79)
channel_0.physion: pair contact (collision state enter/stay) on any native frame in (3f - 3, 3f], absorbed past the end

parser_targets.clevrer: presence = inside_camera_view; center = H(x, y) / (480, 320) with the frozen homography H (valid if in view and inside the image); kind = shape
parser_targets.physion: presence = >= 16 pixels of the object's segmentation colour; center = mask centroid / 256; kind = role

descriptive: rollout-error table (all nine requests + J + J-cont, both benchmarks, pixel carrier)
dispositions.guard_failure: a failed guard turns every token into readiness_or_precision_insufficient

primary.claim: request-selected rollouts with description levels (J) beat the horizon-only baseline (J-cont) on the benchmark's own decision at equal training compute

contrasts.clevrer: J - J-cont, CLEVRER per-option accuracy (predictive + counterfactual)
contrasts.physion: J - J-cont, Physion OCP test accuracy (simulated readout protocol)

dispositions.rule: #114 rule: supported iff mean >= margin and lower > 0; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff upper < margin; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient

secondary.J_minus_fixed: J - F-k for each of the nine fixed requests, same rule
secondary.label_free: J(label-free) - J(hybrid) on Physion OCP and both rollout errors (non-inferiority reading: not_supported iff upper < -margin is reported)

encoder.loss: E99/#70 parser_loss terms: presence x4, class-balanced presence x4, count MSE, smooth-L1 centers, kind CE; relation/macro parser heads untrained

guards.G1: split isolation: encoder / predictor / policy pools contain no scored clip (CLEVRER scene indices disjoint; Physion: no full static parameter set (PHYSION_PARAMETERS) shared across dynamics / readout / testing; shared file names and fixed generator layouts are reported)
guards.G2: every scoring record carries the deterministic scoring policy
guards.G3: chronology: plan frozen before the first encoder / predictor update, records after training
guards.G4: completeness: every planned member trained or a recorded typed failure; every record finite
guards.G5: pixels only at test time: spot re-parse of scored clips from pixels equals the cached carrier (max abs difference <= 1e-4) and a spot re-score equals the record
guards.G6: data manifest: every archive sha256 / size / S3 ETag matches

hardware: 4 x RTX 5090 (32 GB) instead of the #85 single RTX 3090

homography.rule: palette-hue blob centroids of uniquely coloured in-view objects, every 8th frame of the first 300 member training videos; RANSAC 4-point DLT (6 px) then least squares on the inliers

owner_decisions.download_scope: CLEVRER videos + QA (train, validation); Physion Dominoes dynamics, readout and testing sets; other Physion scenarios out of scope
owner_decisions.encoder: #99 spatial slot parser (E99), not JEPA (owner comment on #106)
owner_decisions.macro: #113 observable definitions, not one-step events (owner comment on #106)

policy.J: request_policy.RequestPolicy(PAIRS) via window_rows (#77 DP labels, DAgger rounds) and distil_round

families.hybrid: predicate_feedback.DeltaMacroPredictor, labels on micro and Delta macro
families.label-free: pixel_carrier.LabelFreeMicroPredictor: #115 binary micro bottleneck without micro labels, Delta macro labelled

predictor.recipe: #112 LC as #117 item 5 adapted it: #77 local loss (pf.local_loss) + long-horizon recursive loss with curriculum, truncation 45, skip-on-nonfinite (patience 10); ranking term dropped (no verdicted inventories)

scoring.equal_compute: every arm of a member uses the same predictor; J and J-cont share the policy recipe; inference MACs are the table's x axis

qa.counterfactual: start one frame before the removed object's first parsed contact (micro head on the parsed carrier >= 0.5), removed slot zeroed (presence, center, motion columns), rollout to frame 127; observed readings up to the start frame count; no parsed contact -> factual

scoring.rollout_error: position MSE (columns 5, 6 under the target's column-7 mask) against the parsed carrier (primary) and the annotation carrier (secondary), per clip mean over contexts
